data: New post — video diffusion models as robot policies

Published a deep-dive on turning open video diffusion models (Cosmos-Predict2 2B, LTX-2.5) into robot policy backbones on a single RTX 4090 — read it here. A LoRA fine-tuned purely on video prediction of the robot’s own data gave the best action policy, and dropping the future frames from the forward pass made feature extraction 5.7x faster.
